name: Summer Quest at the Greater Bergen County YMCA
operator_name: Greater Bergen County YMCA (Metropolitan YMCA of the Oranges)
description_short: New weekly YMCA day camp at the New Milford Program Center for ages 5 to 12, mixing enrichment, sports, active play and teamwork.
notes: Camp 8:30 am to 4 pm. Before care 7:30 to 8:30 am ($27.50 a week) and after care 4 to 6 pm ($40 a week). 5 percent down payment per week. Families pack lunch and snacks. Any family can register; the page does not say whether $385 is the member or community rate. Registration opens December 1, 2026.
